Purpose and exclusions

Apply combat math and status rules once, through GAS-backed authoritative execution. Healing, damage types, criticals, buffs/debuffs, crowd control and cast interruption are authored rules, not hardcoded UI labels or sprite animation side effects.

Never bypass the declared rule owner, mutate an authored definition at runtime, trust a client completion claim, or infer a compiled implementation from this page.

Creation and configuration

  1. Author GE_Damage, GE_Healing and representative burn/slow/stun effects with definitions/tags. Keep periodic damage on the authority and use stable effect context for credit.
  2. Set training dummy armor to 20, attacker level to 1 and raw physical amount to 20: expected pre-round damage is 20*(1-20/130), approximately 16.923; record the chosen rounding policy.
  3. Create an interruptible Arcanist cast and a Warden heal targeting Ally_A. Configure cancel tags and remove skeletal montage prerequisites.
  4. Bind WBP_HUD resource bars/status rows to ASC delegates. Tooltips explain damage type and resistance without independently recomputing hidden server rolls.
  5. Reopen death, threat and combat-log consumers: damage accepted emits one verified event; no UI event can grant kill credit.

Required sequence: create native prerequisites -> actual build -> child/data creation -> configure -> assign to listed consumer -> save -> run named fixture. A compiled shell without its consumer assignment is not feature completion.

Lifecycle and cleanup

  1. Construct with only safe defaults; no service calls or world scans from construction scripts.
  2. Inject current owner/definition/session and subscribe once after readiness. Possession and replicated state may arrive in either order; guard initialization.
  3. Accept only permitted commands under current identity/epoch; keep local UI/cosmetic prediction separate from committed state.
  4. After server/backend result apply only matching request generation and nonstale revision; late reply to old body does not mutate new body.
  5. On death, transfer, disconnect, restart or teardown cancel transient work, clear input/timers, unbind delegates and release weak observers. Durable receipts remain authoritative.
  6. On reconnect create fresh runtime objects from current committed snapshot; never deserialize old Actor/widget pointers or rerun initial grants.

Concrete player-to-authority flow

Participation in Damage, healing, resistances, status effects and interruption. Rule owner: URPGEffectRules. This asset’s role is Apply combat math and status rules once, through GAS-backed authoritative execution. Healing, damage types, criticals, buffs/debuffs, crowd control and cast interruption are authored rules, not hardcoded UI labels or sprite animation side effects.

  1. Read accepted attacker stats and target mitigation under the definition's snapshot/dynamic policy; never calculate different authoritative formulas in UI, Character and ability.
  2. Compute raw amount, outgoing modifiers, mitigation/resistance, critical outcome and incoming modifiers in the documented order, then clamp finite bounds and health resources.
  3. Server applies the resulting GAS effect; death is detected once by the health/defeat owner rather than each damage source.
  4. Healing validates friendly policy and caps at missing health; overheal may be recorded but is not extra XP or threat unless explicitly authored.
  5. Status application evaluates immunity, stacking, duration, periodic tick ownership and interruption. A canceled channel stops future ticks but does not undo already committed impacts.
  6. Replicate effect tags/resource outcomes and semantic cues; UI shows duration from server time and clears stale icons on avatar replacement.

Named fixture and acceptance

Fixture: L_NetworkLab / ArmoredDummy / Ally_A / StatusProbe. Configure this asset at its first phase and run the linked phase recipe. Actual result: not run in Unreal/backend during documentation generation.

Stimulus / expected result
NaN/negative/unbounded input -> InvalidDefinition/Payload, no attribute corruption.
Heal dead target without resurrection ability -> TargetDead.
Apply same nonstacking effect twice -> refresh/reject per policy, not accidental double periodic ticks.
Interrupt stale action sequence -> Stale; current new cast continues.

Record expected/observed separately. Reopen the concrete map consumer; inspect authoritative state, stable IDs/revisions and UI. Static link checks cannot satisfy this gameplay test.

Common mistakes and staged limits

Do not duplicate a native rule in Blueprint, assume a planned type is compiled, or keep callbacks/owners valid after world or session replacement.

Do not build later references as empty shells in an earlier phase. Source-derived art rows remain blocked by the missing ZIP; plugin API bindings remain blocked by installed-source verification. Placeholder visuals and proposed tuning are explicitly not production proof.
